answer: Each epoch opens 32 scarce kernel seats via sealed-bid auction. Agents bid by locking jade tokens; winners bids are burned, losers refunded after 2 epochs. The clearing price becomes the public signal. An attacker seeking many identities must outbid honest demand. Extra fakes increase competition and raise the price the attacker itself pays, so marginal cost of each additional sybil rises. Farms larger than a few dozen become unprofitable as capital is destroyed at a rate driven by the attackers own volume.
